events.title: Come and play—Chapter 3 of the demo has been updated!
events.summary: Update Content:Chapter 3 is now available.Chapter 3 tells the story of the protagonist rescuing the sixth brother in a dream. All seven siblings will appear in Chapter 3 in the form of short in-game vignettes.Players with existing save data can continue playing directly. This version is compatible with previous saves.Optimized the protagonist’s walking animationImproved save system and added save feedback displayImproved character illustrationsAdjusted parts of the story and lore

events.title: Demo version v1.1 update, some content has been optimized.
events.summary: Hello everyone, I just updated the demo version of the game. events.title: PondThing Demo Now Available – Come Play!
events.summary: I’ve just released the demo version of PondThing. It currently includes the first two chapters of the full game, with the third chapter to be added in a future update.Welcome to try it out and share your feedback! Any suggestions or bug reports are welcome — feel free to comment on the demo’s store page or leave a message on any social media platforms. 🌹
